messages:
ara: Quick sync request — we need a definitive owner list + milestones for the v1 -> v2 rollout. Target sunset for v1 is 2026-05-01. Who owns SDKs, gateway compat, docs, and customer comms?

jordan: I can own the public comms + tracking in the roadmap board. I'll add milestones: announce -> deprecation window -> final cut.

maria: Platform note: need to confirm routing fallback behaviour when v1 is disabled. We have two things: automatic mapping to v2 variants and traffic-shaping policy. @sam can you confirm SDK header support for fallback?

sam: SDKs can add a deprecation header and opt-in compatibility layer. PR open: https://git.internal/s/sdks/merge_requests/452
sam: ETA for stable release is 2026-02-10 if we don't hit regressions.

kevin: Release calendar conflict: Dedicated infra maintenance planned 2026-02-08 -> 02-12. We should avoid the SDK major cutover during that window.

linh: Compliance check: audit logs schema will change once we switch endpoints. Need to confirm retention and migration for exported logs. I'll own the audit schema plan.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy succeeded for gateway-v2 canary (canary-3) — 12:03 UTC.

ara: Thanks. Can everyone add a short bullet in the roadmap card with: owner, blocking dependencies, and expected completion date? Example bullets:
- SDKs: sam — 2026-02-10 (depends on docs + release window)
- Gateway routing: maria — 2026-01-20 (depends on config rollout)
- Docs & migration guide: jordan — 2026-01-15
- Audit schema: linh — 2026-01-25

jordan: I'll draft the customer email cadence: announce (60d), reminder (30d), final (7d). Share in #marketing once done.

maria: One more infra ask: enable per-route compatibility flags and a fast rollback. Config snippet for ops:
```
route:
  match: /v1/*
  action: redirect
  target: /v2/$1
  headers:
    - X-Deprecation-Notice: "v1 sunsetting 2026-05-01; see /migrate-v2"
```

sam: Note on SDK compatibility: we'll keep v1 client constructor but warn on init if server reports deprecation header. Suggestion: deprecation warning is a single telem event to avoid noise.

kevin: I'll block the release dates around the infra maintenance and propose we do major cutover week of 2026-02-15 instead.

linh: For regulated customers we need a pre-notice + optional extended support window. Jordan — can you coordinate legal + sales for exceptions?

ara: Yep — @jordan please add a checklist item for extended-support requests and assign to sales-eng. Also tagging @kevin to avoid overlapping infra changes.

jordan: Will do. I'll ping sales-eng after the roadmap card is updated.

maria: All good from platform side besides the rollback automation. I'll open a small infra RFC tomorrow.

sam: Ack — will align SDK release with that RFC.

ara: Great. Action items summary (please reply with ✅ when done):
- Add roadmap bullets (owners/dates) — everyone owning a part
- sam: finalize SDK PR + release plan
- maria: RFC for rollback automation
- jordan: customer comms + extended support workflow
- linh: audit schema migration doc

kevin: ✅ I'll move the infra window if we need to.

jordan: ✅ roadmap card updated.

sam: ✅ PR green, merging once docs are live.

maria: ✅ RFC opened: https://go/repo/rfcs/187

ara: Thanks all. I'll compile a single checklist and post in the board by EOD. :thumbsup:
